paper_title: Morphosyntactic probing of multilingual BERT models
caption: The average probing accuracy using different MLP variations. We indicate the size(s) of hidden layer(s) in square brackets.
model_annotation: The bar chart illustrates the average probing accuracy differences between mBERT and XLM-R across various MLP configurations, with the y-axis representing the "% point difference" in accuracy ranging from -0.2 to 0.2. The x-axis displays four different MLP setups: "hidden:[50], linear", "hidden:[], linear", "hidden:[100], ReLU", and "hidden:[50, 50], ReLU". For each setup, two bars are shown: a light blue bar for mBERT and a dark blue bar for XLM-R. In the "hidden:[50], linear" configuration, mBERT shows a negative difference of approximately -0.18, while XLM-R shows a smaller negative difference of about -0.07. In "hidden:[], linear", mBERT has a positive difference of around 0.08, and XLM-R has a significantly higher positive difference of about 0.21. For "hidden:[100], ReLU", mBERT has a negative difference of approximately -0.12, and XLM-R has a small positive difference of about 0.03. In the "hidden:[50, 50], ReLU" setup, mBERT shows a negative difference of around -0.16, and XLM-R has a negative difference of about -0.13. The legend in the top right corner identifies the light blue bars as mBERT and the dark blue bars as XLM-R.
